queries.name: ListReportAttempts
queries.returns: attempt state, scope, as-of, counts, artifact verification summary/failure code; never staged row bodies in list

queries.name: GetReportAttempt
queries.returns: request metadata, state machine, snapshot counts/hash, artifact hash/size/verified_at, failure/cancel info and registered section summaries

queries.name: ListReportMemberSnapshots
inputs: completed report id or privileged in-progress diagnostic review
queries.returns: minimized report member evidence and tier results

queries.name: ReadSealedReportSnapshotForArtifact
rules: requires attempt ready_to_generate/generating/verifying and exact sealed hash
streams deterministic member/cohort/section rows without querying live operational tables
completed reports remain readable by exact immutable snapshot identity

authority_rules: in-progress staging rows are technical attempt data and not historical authority
completed report child rows are immutable evidence and all readers identify report-time as_of/timezone/scope
external artifact absence/movement does not invalidate completed database evidence
failed/cancelled attempts expose bounded metadata only after staging cleanup
